script: 中華航空公司CI100班機飛往東京成田的旅客請注意，本班機登機門由A5更改為B7，請前往B7登機門候機。
Attention passengers on China Airlines flight CI100 to Tokyo Narita. Your departure gate has been changed from A5 to B7.
華航CI100班機因機件檢修，起飛時間延後至十五點二十分，造成不便敬請見諒。
China Airlines flight CI100 to Tokyo is delayed. The new departure time is 3:20 PM. We apologize for the inconvenience.
搭乘中華航空CI100班機前往東京的旅客，現在開始登機，請至A5登機門登機。
China Airlines flight CI100 to Tokyo Narita is now boarding at gate A5. Passengers seated in rows 40 to 60 may board now.
這是CI100班機飛往東京的最後登機廣播，尚未登機的旅客請立即前往A5登機門。
This is the final boarding call for China Airlines flight CI100 to Tokyo. All remaining passengers please proceed immediately to gate A5.
中華航空公司宣布，CI100班機飛往東京成田因天候因素取消，請旅客至航空公司櫃檯辦理後續事宜。
China Airlines regrets to announce that flight CI100 to Tokyo Narita has been cancelled. Please contact the transfer desk for assistance.
長榮航空BR192班機飛往東京羽田的旅客請注意，登機門更改為C3。
Attention please. EVA Air flight BR192 to Tokyo Haneda is now departing from gate C3.
中華航空CI110班機飛往東京成田，起飛時間延後至十六點。
China Airlines flight CI110 to Tokyo Narita is delayed until 4 PM.
星宇航空JX800班機飛往東京成田的旅客，現在開始登機，請至A8登機門。
Starlux flight JX800 to Tokyo Narita is now boarding at gate A8.
中華航空CI101班機前往大阪的旅客，這是最後登機廣播，請至A6登機門。
Final call for China Airlines flight CI1000 to Hong Kong at gate D2.
旅客您好，請勿將行李放置無人看管，可疑物品請通知服務人員。
For your safety, please do not leave your baggage unattended at any time.
陳大明先生，搭乘CI100班機前往東京的陳大明先生，請立即到A5登機門櫃檯。
Passenger Wang Mei-ling traveling on CI100 to Tokyo, please report to the gate A5 counter immediately.
華航C-I一零零班機，登機門改到B七。
Flight C-I one zero zero to Narita, gate change, now gate B seven.
CI100班機起飛時間延後，新的登機時間將另行廣播。
China Airlines flight CI100 is delayed. A new departure time will be announced shortly.
搭乘國泰航空CX451班機前往香港的旅客，登機門由A5改為A9。
Cathay Pacific flight CX451 to Hong Kong, gate A5 has changed to A9.
中華航空CI100與CI110班機旅客請注意，CI100改至B7登機門，CI110維持A7。
Passengers on CI110, your gate remains A7. Passengers on CI100 please note your new gate is B7.
中華航空公司CI100班機飛往東京成田的旅客請注意，因颱風影響，本班機起飛時間提前至十點五十分，請儘速前往A5登機門。
Attention passengers on China Airlines flight CI100 to Tokyo Narita. Due to the typhoon, departure has been moved earlier to 10:50 AM. Please proceed to gate A5 now.
華航CI110班機飛往東京成田，因颱風影響，起飛時間提前至九點二十五分。
China Airlines flight CI110 to Tokyo Narita will now depart earlier, at 9:25 AM.
CI100班機飛往東京的旅客請注意，本班機登機門由B7改回A5，請回到A5登機門候機。
Passengers on CI100 to Tokyo, your gate has changed back from B7 to A5.
更正廣播：中華航空CI100班機登機門仍為A5，先前更改至B7的廣播有誤，造成不便敬請見諒。
Correction: China Airlines flight CI100 will depart from gate A5 as originally scheduled, not gate B7. We apologize for the confusion.
中華航空CI100班機飛往東京成田的旅客請注意，登機門更改為B1R。
Gate change for China Airlines flight CI100 to Tokyo Narita. Your new gate is B1R.
Flight C-I one hundred to Narita, gate change, now gate B one R.
星宇航空JX800班機飛往東京成田的旅客，登機門更改為B1R。
中華航空公司宣布，因颱風影響，以下班機取消：CI130飛往札幌、CI110飛往東京成田、CI100飛往東京成田，請旅客至航空公司櫃檯辦理後續事宜。
Due to the typhoon, China Airlines regrets to announce the cancellation of the following flights: CI130 to Sapporo, CI110 to Tokyo Narita, and CI100 to Tokyo Narita.
長榮航空宣布，因颱風影響，以下班機取消：BR196飛往東京成田、BR198飛往東京成田、BR116飛往札幌。
Due to the typhoon, the following flights are cancelled: CI101 to Osaka, CI1000 to Hong Kong, and CI10 to Los Angeles.
澳門航空NX631、NX611、NX615、NX621班機因颱風全部取消。
